UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated learner profile metadata for Study Genius AI.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

CloudStudyNote.title: CloudStudyNote
CloudStudyNote.description: Cloud-persisted AI study note, document summary, or saved AI chat answer.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

style.description: Formatting style such as Short Notes, Exam Revision, PDF Summary, or Step-by-Step.

sourceName.description: Optional source document filename or empty string.

content.description: Full markdown or plain-text study content.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

CloudQuiz.title: CloudQuiz
CloudQuiz.description: Cloud-persisted generated quiz or timed mock test with native question maps.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the quiz owner.

sourceType.description: Origin type of the quiz material.

questionCount.description: Number of questions in the quiz.

questions.description: Native list of structured question objects (index, question, options, correctAnswer, explanation, type).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

CloudQuizAttempt.title: CloudQuizAttempt
CloudQuizAttempt.description: Immutable historical quiz or mock test attempt result.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner.

quizId.description: Document ID of the associated CloudQuiz.

quizTitle.description: Snapshot of the quiz title at attempt time.

mockTest.description: Whether the attempt was a timed mock test.

timeSpentSeconds.description: Duration spent completing the quiz in seconds.

userAnswers.description: Native map from question index string to submitted answer.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on completion.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile document scoped strictly to the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Per-user cloud study notes, document summaries, and saved AI explanations.

/users/{userId}/quizzes/{quizId}.description: Per-user cloud quizzes and mock tests.

/users/{userId}/quizAttempts/{attemptId}.description: Per-user persistent quiz history and performance analytics.
